- **Grid → Detail** (forward): old page slides out left, new slides in from right
- **Detail → Grid** (back): old page slides out right, new slides in from left
- Controlled via `transitionType` prop on `ViewTransitionLink` and CSS `active-view-transition-type()` selectors

### Skeleton → content transitions
- Product details use a `fade-in-up` CSS animation (`.product-info` in `globals.css:186`)
- `FadeIn` component wraps content to attempt `document.startViewTransition()` for browsers that support it

### Reduced motion support
- `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` disables all view transition animations and sets animation/transition durations to effectively zero

### New components
- **`app/ViewTransitionLink.tsx`** — replaces `<Link>`, wraps navigation in `document.startViewTransition()` with a MutationObserver to correctly capture old/new DOM states
- **`app/FadeIn.tsx`** — wraps Suspense-resolved content for smooth appearance
